limits: Simulated production InputSystem; normal camera, genuine foreground; development build at 1920x1080/60fps target/VSync 0
Four room workloads each exceed 60 contiguous focused eligible seconds; prepared-method eligible holds are about 9.88 seconds after capture guards
Isolated full-route CPU stalls remain included and unassigned; do not silently remove them or assert GC/host/implementation causality
Only 1080p current foreground performance measured; not minimum-spec, 720p or probe-free shipping certification
No draw/batch counters were collected by the existing probe

50,114,560-byte managed sample buffer plus retained full-resolution RenderTexture and proof overhead; occasional native window snapshots are supporting observations and their overhead was not subtracted
Constant-zero Unity working-set counter is unusable; use external process high-water and positive Profiler memory counters
GC allocation counters are observations, not proof of collection cause or a collection-count measurement

comparison.baselineTier: Uncapped pose-held offscreen Q1 harness; controller/UI held; not normal-camera frame or GPU timing
comparison.conclusion: No apples-to-apples speed ratio: current wall time includes a 60fps wait and normal gameplay/UI/probe overhead. Compare actual current CPU active/GPU cost and sustained room coverage; no hardware acceptance inferred.
